title: Building an AI App — Design the Failure Experience
key_insight: Show clear retry, edit, or manual paths. Preserve the user’s input and avoid claiming success before downstream work completes.
body:
## Design the Failure Experience

The model times out, refuses, or produces invalid structure. A blank screen turns a model limitation into a product failure.

Show clear retry, edit, or manual paths. Preserve the user’s input and avoid claiming success before downstream work completes.

Use feature flags and staged rollout. A small audience reveals cost, latency, and misunderstanding before full exposure.
common_mistakes: Adding a chat box automatically creates user value.
Fluent output proves the user task succeeded.
A production app needs no fallback path.
mini_exercise: Draw “Design the Failure Experience” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: A useful AI app connects a clear user job to context, model calls, validation, feedback, and fallback behavior.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Design the Failure Experience” to explain Building an AI App plainly.
